title: Classification of solutions to an $n^{\text{th}}$ order conformally invariant elliptic equation on $\mathbb R^n$ with nonlocal nonlinearity
summary: This paper concerns a conformally invariant elliptic problem on $\mathbb R^n$ driven by $(-Δ)^{n/2}$ that has a nonlocal exponential nonlinearity of Choquard type. The problem under consideration is a nonlocal generalization of the constant $Q$-curvature problem on $\mathbb R^n$. We classify the asymptotic behavior at infinity of all solutions that satisfy a suitable integrability assumption. Under a growth restriction at infinity and a lower bound on the energy we provide an explicit classification for solutions.
